description: This Java source file defines Swagger API documentation classes for self account transfer endpoints in the Fineract project, including request and response schemas for transfer templates and transfer actions.

classes.name: SelfAccountTransferApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: Contains nested classes defining Swagger schemas for account transfer API requests and responses.

classes.name: GetAccountTransferTemplateResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response template when retrieving account transfer options.

classes.name: GetAccountOptions
classes.description: Represents account type options with id, code, and description.

classes.name: GetFromAccountOptions
classes.description: Details of source account options for transfer, including account info and client/office details.

classes.name: GetToAccountOptions
classes.description: Details of destination account options for transfer, similar to source account info.

classes.name: PostNewTransferRequest
classes.description: Schema for creating a new transfer request, including source/destination account info, date, amount, and description.

classes.name: PostNewTransferResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response after creating a new transfer, including savingsId and resourceId.
